n_candidates.meaning: number of candidate plans in the frozen pool

selected_plan.meaning: id of the plan the agent selected and reported

tournament_champion.meaning: plan ranked first by the tournament

order_consistency.meaning: share of plan pairs judged the same way in both presentation orders

selected_true_rank.meaning: rank of the selected plan among all candidates under the evaluator's unified score (1 = best)

best_true_plan.meaning: plan with the best unified score

selection_gap.meaning: unified score of the best candidate minus that of the selected plan

n_genes_judgeable.meaning: in-scope genes whose ceiling is above the permutation null on held-out cells

ceiling_r.meaning: mean per-gene r of the RNA-to-RNA ceiling

cluster_mean_r.meaning: mean per-gene r of the cell-type (cluster-mean) baseline

ridge_r.meaning: mean per-gene r of ridge regression on the ATAC latent space

gene_activity_r.meaning: mean per-gene r of the gene-activity score

depth_r.meaning: mean per-gene r from ATAC depth alone

selected_true_r.meaning: unified score of the selected plan: mean per-gene r on held-out cells

selected_self_r.meaning: score the selected plan reported for itself in its full run

selected_inflation.meaning: self-reported minus unified score of the selected plan

mean_inflation.meaning: mean of self-reported minus unified score over candidates

selected_fraction_of_ceiling.meaning: unified score of the selected plan as a share of the ceiling

selected_delta_vs_cluster.meaning: mean per-gene r of the selected plan minus the cluster-mean baseline on held-out cells

n_beyond.meaning: genes the selected plan predicts beyond cell type on held-out cells (FDR 5%)

n_not_beyond.meaning: judgeable genes not beyond the cell-type baseline

share_beyond.meaning: genes predicted beyond cell type as a share of judgeable genes

n_claimed.meaning: genes the plan itself claimed from development cells

replication_rate.meaning: share of the plan's claimed genes confirmed on held-out cells

within_cluster_r.meaning: mean per-gene r of the selected plan inside clusters

max_beyond_any_plan.meaning: largest number of genes beyond cell type achieved by any candidate
